verses.text: A Song of Ascents. Of David
O Jehovah, my heart is not proud, Nor are my eyes haughty; Nor do I go about in things too great Or too wondrous for me.

; Nor do I go about in things too great Or too wondrous for me.

verses.text: Surely I have calmed And quieted my soul, Like a weaned child with its mother; Like a weaned child is my soul within me.
Hope in Jehovah, O Israel, From now and to eternity.
